run_text_infilling: run code infilling on Python, Bash, and Lean code snippets using a Llama model checkpoint
build_llama_generator: build a Llama generator from a checkpoint directory and tokenizer path for inference
run_infilling_batch: run batch text infilling on multiple prefix-suffix pairs with configurable temperature and top_p
run_code_completion: run code completion for function bodies, class constructors, and shell commands using Code Llama
run_infilling_cli: run the infilling CLI with custom max sequence length, generation length, and batch size
